basic_info.description: Spacious 3BD/1.5BA Modified Edwardian w/Craftsman touches in Crocker Amazon. Built in the 1920s, this charming home offers vintage details, generous living space, and a deep flexible-use basement/garage. Formal entry leads to oversized formal living room w/bay windows, original built-ins, wood-burning fireplace, and hardwood floors w/inlay. Adjacent formal dining room has box beam ceilings and period wainscoting. Sunny rear kitchen features ample cabinet storage, vintage tile, breakfast area, and direct access to a full-width rear deck and fenced yard. Powder rm nearby. Upper level features 3BDs off a wide hallway including a large front-facing primary BD w/natural light and neighborhood views. Full BA w/vintage finishes. Rear BD connects to a bright bonus room perfect for an office, nursery, or playroom. Expansive garage/basement offers high ceilings, laundry hookups, storage, multi-car pkg, and expansion potential (buyer to verify). Landscaped backyard w/patio fountain and space to garden, relax, or play.
